chats.answer:
I'd buy the REDTIGER A3 for a three-channel dash cam under $100. I'm assuming you want simultaneous front, rear, and interior recording, and that your $100 limit is before tax.

REDTIGER A3 3-Channel Dash Cam

$72.19

Walmart - Redtiger Official · 4.2/5 (39 reviews)

Best overall pick. Records 2.5K front, 1080p rear and 1080p cabin. Includes Wi-Fi, infrared cabin night vision and a 32GB card. Sold by REDTIGER's official Walmart seller.

Vantrue N4 3-Channel Dash Cam

$99.99

Walmart · 4.0/5 (154 reviews)

Worth considering at this sale price. The listing advertises 1440p front, 1440p cabin and 1080p rear simultaneously, plus infrared night vision. Check the exact variant, seller and memory-card inclusion before buying. 
Black - Walmart.com

TOGUARD 1080p 3-Channel Dash Cam

$49.99

Walmart - Camerasmall · 3.9/5 (37 reviews)

Budget pick. Includes a 64GB card and infrared night vision, but its 1080p front and 720p secondary cameras offer less detail.

The main compromise at this price is nighttime license-plate capture. A high advertised resolution doesn't guarantee readable plates, especially in motion. Also, continuous parking recording generally requires a separate power kit. 
Digital Camera World

Bottom line: Get the A3 for the balanced, ready-to-use package. I haven't independently tested these three cameras, so this is a specs-and-price recommendation, not a verified video-quality ranking. Prices may change at checkout.

chats.answer:
I'd buy the REDTIGER A3 if you can get it below $100. Assuming you want three cameras recording the front, rear, and cabin simultaneously, it's my pick for the best balance of features and seller confidence at this budget.

Best 3-channel dash cams under $100

REDTIGER A3 3-Channel Dash Cam

$72.19

Walmart - Redtiger Official · 4.2/5 (39 reviews)

Best overall. Advertised 2.5K front, 1080p rear and cabin, infrared cabin night vision, Wi-Fi, GPS, and an included 32GB card. Sold by REDTIGER's official marketplace store.

Odrey 2.5K 3-Channel Dash Cam

$49.99

Walmart - Mileone · 4.4/5 (58 reviews)

Best cheaper alternative. Similar advertised recording resolutions, 5.8GHz Wi-Fi, and a larger 64GB card. Less established support history.

TOGUARD 1080p 3-Channel Dash Cam

$49.99

Walmart - Camerasmall · 3.9/5 (37 reviews)

Best around $50. Includes a 64GB card and infrared cabin illumination, but the front records at 1080p and the other two cameras at just 720p.

The important compromise: I couldn't verify independent, side-by-side night footage or long-term reliability tests for these exact models. Don't assume any will reliably capture moving license plates at night, regardless of advertised resolution. If that's your priority and you don't need cabin footage, I'd spend the same budget on a better two-channel camera.

Prices are before tax, and the listings show conflicting promotional prices, so check the final checkout total. Parking recording may also require a separately purchased hardwire kit.
